i.norm: Copying a {@link SummaryStatistics} instance onto itself must be a safe no-op: even after every pluggable statistic implementation has been replaced with a custom one, copying source-to-source leaves the observed sample count untouched. Since no values were ever added, the count stays 0.
Override every pluggable statistic with the same custom implementation.
Copying the instance onto itself should not corrupt its state.
